resources.string: Tap the mic key on your keyboard, speak, tap done. Words appear where you were typing. Nothing leaves the phone.
Turn Say on in keyboard settings
Pick Say from your keyboard\'s mic key, or from the keyboard switcher
Listening — tap Done when you have finished
Nothing heard. Try again, a little closer to the phone.
The field went away, so the text is on your clipboard.
Turn Say on in keyboard settings
In any app, open the keyboard switcher — the globe key on Gboard, or the keyboard icon at the bottom of the screen — and pick Say. Speak, tap the mark, and your keyboard comes back on its own.
Say needs the microphone to hear you.
Puts a floating Say mark over your apps; tap it to dictate into the field you are in.

Say uses this to place the words you dictate at the cursor of the text field that has focus, and to show its floating mark while a keyboard is up. It reads nothing else on screen, stores nothing it sees, and never sends anything off the phone.
A floating mark over every app, above the keyboard. Tap it, speak, tap again: the words land at your cursor, whichever keyboard you use. Hold it to cancel; drag it to move it.
On — the mark appears when a keyboard is up
Off. Turn on “Say” under Accessibility to enable it.
It needs the Accessibility permission, which is the only way an app can type into another app on Android. Say uses it for exactly that and for nothing else.
Say won’t dictate into a password field.
No text field here — the words are on your clipboard.
Nothing yet. Your dictations will appear here.
Bigger models hear more. They download once from moonshine.ai and then work offline.
Not enough free space for this model.
Capitals, full stops, collapsed decoder loops. Rules only, no model.
End sentences with a full stop
Return to my keyboard after dictating
Off keeps Say up so you can dictate again with one tap.
Names and jargon, one per line. Say biases the decoder toward them and repairs near-misses afterwards.
Always swap a phrase, one per line, as heard = wanted.
Field went away — copied to clipboard
